title: Spiced Fennel and Caramel Sweet Rice Bowl
description: A flavorful Indian-inspired rice bowl dish featuring caramelized sweet potatoes, crunchy fennel, and aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced fennel and cook until tender and lightly browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the cubed sweet potatoes to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together the garam masala, turmeric, salt, and black pepper.
Sprinkle the spice mixture over the sweet potatoes and fennel, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the spices are fragrant.
Serve the spiced fennel and sweet potatoes over cooked white rice, garnished with chopped cilantro.
Optional: Add a dollop of coconut cream or a sprinkle of toasted nuts for added flavor and texture.
